title: Unwanted hair
caption: Unwanted hair isn't really one problem - it's the catch-all for hair growing where you'd rather it didn't, in patterns shaped by genetics, hormones (PCOS, thyroid) and age. Shaving, waxing, threading and creams manage the surface; longer-term reduction needs to act on the follicle itself. Knowing which it actually is - a maintenance preference, or something hormonal worth checking - changes what makes sense to do about it. Not medical advice, just the honest basics. Learn more at cliniclick.ae
